ModbusCmd.Title: State [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Condition of the Charging device 0 EVSE not available - state F 1 EVSE available - state A 2 Plug detected - state A+ 3 reserved 4 EV connected – state B 5 EV connected – state C- 6 EV connected, ventilation required – state D- 7 EVSE ready - state B+ 8 EV ready - state C 9 Charging EV - state C+ 10 EV ready, ventilation required – state D 11 Charging EV, ventilation required -- state D+ 12 Stop charging 13 Alarm 14 Shortcut – state E 15 Digital Com by EVSE state

ModbusCmd.Title: Charger State[1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Status of the charging process: 0: Charging process not started (no vehicle connected) 1: Connected, waiting for release (by RFID or Local) 2: Charging process starts 3: Shop 4: Suspended (loading paused) 5: Charging process successfully completed (Vehicle still plugged in) 6: Charging process completed by user (vehicle still plugged in) 7: Charging ended with error (vehicle still connected)

ModbusCmd.Title: Connector Type [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: 0 invalid 1 DC-CCS 2 DC CHAdeMO 3 AC Typ 2

ModbusCmd.Title: Maximum Charging Power [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Maximum Charging Power (EV) requested by the vehicle. [W] 0 if no vehicle attached

ModbusCmd.Title: Minimum Charging Power [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Minimum Charging Power (EV) requested by the vehicle. [W] 0 if no vehicle attached

ModbusCmd.Title: State charging point
ModbusCmd.HintText: Condition of the Charger 0: Not Ready 1: Available 2: Charging 3: Suspended 10: Faulted

ModbusCmd.Title: Available Charging Power[1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Available power for the connector [W] (keep in mind that there are vehicles on the market which stop the charging process when the charging power is set to zero for too long, even when <Minimum charging power (EV)> is zero)

ModbusCmd.Title: Suspend Mode [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Pause charging: 0: no pause 1: Charging pause (leave locking etc. on) (keep in mind that there are vehicles on the market which stop the charging process when the charging is suspended for too long)

ModbusCmd.Title: Charge Control [1]
ModbusCmd.HintText: Control charging process: 0: do nothing 1: Manually authorize and start charging process 2: Cancel charging process

ModbusCmd.Title: Communication Timeout
ModbusCmd.HintText: Timeout in seconds for communication failure: 0: Deactivate Time Out 10-600= 10-600 seconds (if no read action is detected on the EVSE side for this time the fallback values apply. This value should be the same as parameterized on the charger itself in the configuration menu)
